# Module: `icescopy_event_navigation`

Review one cell's recorded freeze events while preserving the chosen cooling cycle across cells.

[Source](../src/icescopy_event_navigation.py) · [API index](API-Reference.md)

The selector below the Cells checkboxes provides previous/next arrows and a dropdown. Explicit actions navigate even when Show freeze frame is off, and Auto-center independently controls centering at the destination. Controls refresh without navigating. Known cooling cycles come from imported frame assignments; unknown cycles use event-order labels without inferring cycle identity.

## Classes

| Class | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [`FreezeEventComboBox`](API-Class-FreezeEventComboBox.md) | Captures the selection context when an event dropdown or keyboard action begins. |
| [`FreezeEventSelector`](API-Class-FreezeEventSelector.md) | Tracks the chosen freeze event and cooling cycle and performs explicit event navigation. |
